definition: Specifies the status of an investigation case.

Confirmation.name: Confirmation
Confirmation.definition: Specifies the status of the investigation, in a coded form.

RejectedModification.name: Rejected Modification
RejectedModification.definition: Reason for the rejection of a modification request, in a coded form.

DuplicateOf.name: Duplicate Of
DuplicateOf.definition: Indicates a duplicated case. |Usage: When present, the case identified in the message must be closed. The case identified as duplicated (in this component) will be pursued.

AssignmentCancellationConfirmation.name: Assignment Cancellation Confirmation
AssignmentCancellationConfirmation.definition: Indicates whether the cancellation of the assignment is confirmed or rejected.|Usage: If yes, the cancellation of the assignment is confirmed.|If no, the cancellation of the assignment is rejected and the investigation process will continue.
